evals.prompt: Generate a 1024x1024 PNG image of a matte black ceramic mug on a walnut desk with soft window light. Save it to outputs/mug.png and use the Codex API configuration without asking me for a key.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the bundled script, resolves Codex base URL/image_api/image_model/key, calls the configured Images or Responses backend, and saves outputs/mug.png.

evals.prompt: Create a transparent-background app icon of a folded paper crane, no text, centered with enough padding. Save as outputs/crane-icon.png.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets background transparent and png output format, calls the configured image backend, and reports the saved file path.

evals.prompt: Restyle reference.png as a polished editorial illustration while preserving composition. Use high input fidelity and save the result to outputs/reference-restyled.png.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses --image reference.png, --action edit, --input-fidelity high, and the Codex API config; if the input file is missing, it reports that specific blocker.

evals.prompt: 生成一段 10 秒、16:9 的 minimax-h3 视频，保存到 outputs/demo.mp4。
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the request to generate-video, sends one POST to /v1/videos with model minimax-h3, duration 10, and aspect_ratio 16:9, then polls /v1/status/{id} and saves the returned video_url as an MP4.

evals.prompt: 使用 reference.png 作为@图片1，生成 12 秒竖屏视频并保存到 outputs/reference-video.mp4。
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to the video script, sends the image as a CUMOB-compatible images value, preserves the @图片1 reference, validates duration 12 and aspect_ratio 9:16, and writes the downloaded video.

evals.prompt: 检查 minimax-h3 视频请求配置，不实际调用接口。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses generate-video --dry-run and reports the redacted create/status endpoints, video model, duration/aspect ratio, and reference counts without exposing credentials or base64 contents.

evals.prompt: 视频任务轮询时第一次状态请求网络中断，但任务之后会成功。不要重复创建任务，继续轮询并保存最终 MP4。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the transient polling network failure as recoverable, sends only one POST create request, continues polling the same task id, writes a task state file, and downloads the completed MP4.

evals.prompt: 生成一张图片，要求使用 CUMOB Images API 的异步模式，并在任务完成后保存结果。
evals.expected_output: The agent sends exactly one Images API create request with async=true, persists the returned task id, polls /v1/status/{id} with exponential backoff, and saves data[].url or data[].b64_json without creating a duplicate task.

evals.prompt: 图片任务创建后本地进程中断，请使用已有任务 ID 恢复，不要重新创建任务。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses generate-image --resume, sends no second POST, polls the existing task, and writes the completed image.
